Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Principal Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 is Principal Project Scientist. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Principal Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Principal Project Scientist post at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates do not need to apply online.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 18 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Principal Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 67,000 per month plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Ph.D or M.Tech in Biomedical with 2 years of experience, or an equivalent bachelor's degree with 5 years of experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, New Delhi - 110016.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
